8ee94608.text: With the absence of trolls in the northlands, the elves of Quel'Thalas bent their efforts towards rebuilding their glorious homeland. The victorious armies of Arathor returned home to southlands of Strom.
8ee94608.title: The Guardians of Tirisfal

c237eb4e.text: Lord Lothar rallied the remnants of Azeroth's armies after their defeat at Stormwind Keep, and then launched a massive exodus across the sea to the northern kingdom of Lordaeron. Convinced that the Horde would overcome all of humanity if left unchecked, the leaders of the seven human nations met and agreed to unite in what would become known as the Alliance of Lordaeron.
c237eb4e.title: The Alliance of Lordaeron

dce1b1cf.text: As the politics and rivalries of the seven human nations waxed and waned, the line of Guardians kept its constant vigil against chaos. There were many Guardians over the years, but only one ever held the magical powers of Tirisfal at any given time. One of the last Guardians of the age distinguished herself as a mighty warrior against the shadow.
dce1b1cf.title: Aegwynn and the Dragon Hunt

ea53b57a.text:
The devastating Second War against the orcish horde left the Alliance of Lordaeron in a state of shock and disarray. The bloodthirsty orcs, led by the mighty warchief, Orgrim Doomhammer, not only smashed their way through the dwarf-held lands of Khaz Modan, but had razed many of Lordaeron's central provinces as well. The unrelenting orcs even succeeded in ravaging the
elves' remote kingdom of Quel'Thalas before their rampage was finally stopped.
ea53b57a.title: Aftermath of the Second War

3649|17d06d6c.text: Dark forces encroach upon our borders, ancient taints resurface, and new evils emerge to topple the delicate balance of the land. In times of such darkness, we all must be vigilant.

Regardless, thank you for your service today, $c. The roads to Auberdine are safe for travel once again.

98042-accept.name: Stygignome
98042-accept.text:
<As you tear away the single page from the Twilight Tome, a foreboding voice floods your mind, uninvited.>

They have failed.

You will be forgotten.

They will lose the eye they gained.
98042-accept.title: It's All Fun and Games Until...

98042-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
98042-progress.text: You look troubled. I am listening.
98042-progress.title: It's All Fun and Games Until...

98247-complete.name: Marcy Baker
98247-complete.text:
You have arrived at the right place! I am happy to mark you down as one of our affiliates. No contracts to sign and no commitments to weigh you down. All we ask of you is your diligence to assist in completing or returning any of our deliveries you find on your travels.

When you do so, you will be compensated with Merchant's Favor that will allow you to purchase goods and services we offer here. In fact, here's a little bit to get you started.

Now, do you happen to have the crate this came from?
98247-complete.title: Shipping Label

98247-progress.name: Marcy Baker
98247-progress.text: Ah, greetings! How can I be of assistance?
